entries.alt: Pale roots and a short green shoot emerge together from one end of a wheat kernel resting in moist soil.
entries.caption: Small roots and a shoot emerge from a grain in the soil. This beginning of growth accompanies Jesus' comparison of a solitary grain with the fruitfulness He connects to His approaching death.
entries.findings: Direct full-original inspection: largely intact elongated grain, distal brush at left; roots and short coleoptile visibly emerge together from basal region at right. Corrects opposite-end root/shoot defect of rejected original. Natural moist soil, macro surface and root texture; no cutaway, bean-like cotyledon halves, diagram or mature ear.
conditions: Early botanical growth is illustrative, not yet the much fruit of the verse and not a claim that literal biological death causes germination.
Preserve rejected original and review75 unchanged.
